title: Independent discovery of halogen-dependent band gaps in pyridinium lead bromides
difficulty_reasons: The agent must independently design exploration and convergence checks while preserving the specified HSE06 no-SOC primary comparison and separating optional relativistic sensitivity models.
It must independently formulate and discriminate structural/orbital explanations while validating three heavy-element periodic systems.

data.description: Three experimental parent CIFs and explicit, separate fundamental/framework/same-k electronic observable and relativistic boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Per-crystal fundamental/framework edge and same-k gaps, assignment and stability evidence, separately labeled optical/SOC claims, independent explanation and limitations.
